projects.name: Illinois Coal to Solar & Energy Storage Initiative at Baldwin
projects.quote: Executing its renewable development pipeline, bringing online the first two projects that are part of its • Illinois Coal to Solar & Energy Storage Initiative at Baldwin (70 MW) and Coffeen (46 MW), revitalizing retired and to-be-retired coal plant sites.

projects.quote: Growing its ownership interest in nuclear by closing on an agreement to acquire the entire 15% minority interest • in its Vistra Vision subsidiary, making Vistra the sole owner of its highly valuable, carbon-free assets.
